features: 20,000mAh High Capacity: With a large 20,000mAh battery capacity, PowerVolt 102 Max provides dependable backup power for smartphones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches and other compatible USB-powered devices, making it suitable for everyday use and travel.
22.5W Fast Charging Support: Delivers up to 22.5W fast charging output for compatible devices, helping provide efficient power delivery and a quick boost when your devices need charging on the go.
Wide Device Compatibility: Designed to provide portable charging for a range of everyday electronics, including smartphones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches and other compatible USB-powered devices.

LED Battery Percentage Display: The built-in digital display shows the remaining battery percentage at a glance, allowing you to monitor available power and easily know when the power bank needs to be recharged.
Smart Chip Safety Protection: Intelligent protection helps safeguard against overcharging, overheating, overcurrent and short circuits, providing added protection during everyday charging.
